action_items: Authentication, OCR, compliance status/score/violations, and reports are MOCKED through frontend localStorage services per the specification; no real backend integration is wired.
Backend suite completed with no tests collected; the only probed backend route /api/ returned 200 Hello World and is not used by these frontend flows.

checks.criterion: Authentication supports signup/login for Normal User and Authorized User, with signup email usable on Login
checks.name: authentication-signup-login-logout
checks.evidence: Created a unique Authorized User account, verified signup forwarded its email to Login, signed in, opened Settings, logged out, and returned to /login.

checks.criterion: Dashboard renders dynamic compliance analytics and recent analysis actions
checks.name: dashboard-compliance-analytics
checks.evidence: Authenticated Dashboard rendered metrics, compliance-trend card, recent analyses, and Upload navigation without blank state.

checks.criterion: Upload supports JPG/JPEG/PNG/PDF selection, drag/drop presentation, preview, metadata, remove, and analysis start
checks.name: upload-package-file-analysis-start
checks.evidence: Selected an in-memory PNG via file input, verified selected filename and Ready to analyze state, entered metadata, and reached the Analysis screen with progress/steps.

checks.criterion: Analysis processing completes and navigates to a dynamic result
checks.name: analysis-completes-dynamic-result
checks.evidence: Uploaded a unique JPEG package, observed Analysis, waited for completion, and verified a result containing the submitted product plus returned score.

checks.criterion: Compliance result and violation details are fully navigable
checks.name: compliance-result-violation-details
checks.evidence: Opened the seeded Premia Roasted Almonds result, verified summary/checklist/violations cards, opened a violation button, and rendered violation details.

checks.criterion: Results history supports status tabs/search and report selection
checks.name: results-history-search-status-navigation
checks.evidence: Opened Results, changed the Compliant status tab, searched Organic Multi-Grain Flour, and opened its matching View result action.

checks.criterion: Reports supports print/share/download actions and disclaimer
checks.name: reports-export-actions-disclaimer
checks.evidence: Rendered report document, package image, and disclaimer; Download PDF emitted a .pdf download; Share and Print controls responded.

checks.criterion: Responsive protected shell and settings work on mobile and desktop
checks.name: responsive-settings-shell
checks.evidence: At 390x844 authenticated shell showed mobile menu, opened sidebar, navigated to Settings, and rendered account/preferences/security cards plus logout.
